classifications.reasoning: Rule detects HTTP requests to /Webnews.exe, a known vulnerable component (CVE-2002-0290). Access to this executable is indicative of exploitation attempts against a public-facing web application.
Rule detects HTTP requests to /webadmin.dll, associated with CVE-2003-0471. This suggests exploitation attempts against a vulnerable web application component.
Rule detects access to /UploadScript11.asp, a known vulnerable IIS script (CVE-2001-0938). This is characteristic of exploitation attempts against a public-facing web server.
Rule detects access to /DirectoryListing.asp, also linked to CVE-2001-0938. Requests to this script indicate attempts to exploit a directory traversal or information disclosure vulnerability in IIS.

Rule detects access to /pcadmin/login.asp (Bugtraq 8103). While this may be a vulnerable login page, the rule only matches the URL path without exploit payloads, making attribution to exploitation less certain.

Rule uses a PCRE to detect format string specifiers (%n, %s, etc.) in the POP3 USER command, a clear indicator of an active format string exploitation attempt against a public-facing mail service (CVE-2003-0391).
Rule matches the specific SMB/DCE-RPC bind sequence used to trigger the RPC DCOM vulnerability (MS03-039, CVE-2003-0528/0605/0715). This is a direct exploitation of a remote service.
Rule detects the XEXCH50 command with a negative length argument, a signature of the Exchange 2000 buffer overflow (CVE-2003-0714, MS03-046). This exploits a public-facing SMTP service.
Rule matches a sadmind RPC query with root credentials (TCP), indicating an exploitation attempt against the Solaris sadmind remote administration service.
Same sadmind RPC root credential query but over UDP; also an exploitation attempt against a remote RPC service.

Rule matches the SMB/DCE-RPC vector for the same Messenger Service overflow (CVE-2003-0717), confirming remote service exploitation via SMB.
